nodes.title: Weeks 1-2: Personal and Social Well-being — Adolescence and Change
nodes.description: Personal and Social Well-being: Physical and emotional changes during adolescence; managing change positively; self-esteem and body image. Creative Arts: Visual art — portrait art and self-expression.

nodes.title: Weeks 3-4: Beginning Knowledge — Life and Living
nodes.description: Beginning Knowledge (Natural Sciences): Cells and microscopic organisms; reproduction in plants and animals; human reproductive system. Technology: Systems and control — investigating how mechanisms work. Physical Education: Ball sports and team tactics.

nodes.title: Weeks 5-6: Personal and Social Well-being — Sexual Health and Rights
nodes.description: Personal and Social Well-being: Sexual health and rights; HIV/AIDS awareness; gender-based violence prevention; healthy decision-making in relationships. Creative Arts: Music — composition, melody and harmony.

nodes.title: Weeks 7-8: Beginning Knowledge — Matter and Materials
nodes.description: Beginning Knowledge (Natural Sciences): Chemical changes; acids and bases; the properties and uses of metals. Physical Education: Gymnastics and creative movement sequences.

nodes.title: Weeks 9-10: Creative Arts and Physical Education Assessment
nodes.description: Creative Arts: Integrated arts project — visual art and performing arts performance assessment. Physical Education: Formal skills assessment. Personal and Social Well-being: Term consolidation.

nodes.title: Weeks 1-2: Beginning Knowledge — Energy and Change
nodes.description: Beginning Knowledge (Natural Sciences): Forces and motion; magnetism; the relationship between electricity and magnetism. Creative Arts: Visual art — graphic design and typography.

nodes.title: Weeks 3-4: Personal and Social Well-being — Environmental Responsibility
nodes.description: Personal and Social Well-being: Environmental responsibility; sustainable living; water and energy conservation; the impact of human activity on the environment. Physical Education: Athletics — advanced track and field.

nodes.title: Weeks 5-6: Beginning Knowledge — Earth and Beyond
nodes.description: Beginning Knowledge (Natural Sciences): The lithosphere; rocks and minerals; soil formation and types. Creative Arts: Drama — advanced drama and theatre techniques, devising original scenes.

nodes.title: Weeks 7-8: Creative Arts — Music and Visual Art
nodes.description: Creative Arts: Music — reading notation, ensemble playing; Visual Art — three-dimensional art and installation. Personal and Social Well-being: Career exploration and future planning.

nodes.title: Weeks 9-10: Assessment and Consolidation
nodes.description: Formal Assessment: Creative Arts portfolio and performance assessment. Physical Education: Practical assessment. Beginning Knowledge: Written assessment on energy, earth and beyond. Personal and Social Well-being: consolidation.
